title: How can a small practice keep website reviews manageable
body:
Try the fictional six-page register and inspect the review queue. Which fields make responsibility clearer, and which make the process harder than it needs to be? Please use synthetic content and never share client matters or private reviewer details. [Web Design for Law Firms](https://webdesignforlawfirms.co.uk/) maintains this project. Discussions cover editorial workflow; technical defects belong in Issues.

Start with the [README](https://github.com/Web-Design-For-Law-Firms/legal-content-review-register#readme), then run the documented example locally.
